title: User-supplied prior probabilities (engage-crucible)
description: Map of hypothesis id to prior probability. Probabilities must sum to 1.0 (±0.01 tolerance is enforced procedurally, not by JSON Schema).

priors.description: Hypothesis id → prior probability. At least 2 hypotheses required.

rationale.description: Why these priors were chosen (prior literature, expert elicitation, replication-budget-shaped priors).
